messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: increment_log_prob in transformed parameters?
parts:
I inadvertently disallowed increment_log_prob in transformed
parameters, although lp__ is still allowed (though marked
as deprecated).

One possibility would be to allow it and have any
statements it invoke turned off if the Jacobians are
turned off. That would allow users to write models that
would work for optimization with transforms.

I'd have to rework some of the code generator to make that
work, but it seems worth thinking about.

- Bob

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] increment_log_prob in transformed parameters?
parts:
I'm a little worried that turning terms off automatically may result in surprising results for users.  Can we add a separate function for adding log determinants which can be used anywhere?  Maybe something like add_transform_logdeterminant?  This could then be turned off when a) doing optimization and b) computing raw log probabilities.

Cheers,
Marcus
